span.p:
Plus three service identities — vendor portal, dashboard and binder,
inbox simulator. None of them can call a model or write a finding.

div.style: color: rgb(120, 53, 15) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
tests/test_iam_boundaries.py
attempts one denied action per agent and asserts it fails.
A test that fails as expected is a feature — screenshot it.

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Why it is load-bearing
a fleet holding one god-credential is a single injection away
from disaster. Least privilege is what makes the screening story
true end to end — the agent that reads evidence cannot email,
and the agent that emails cannot touch internal data.

svg.text: Drawbridge — Zero-trust fleet identity: the permission matrix is a deliverable, not config
